const shopify = $input.first().json;
const lineItem = shopify.line_items.find(i => i.title.toLowerCase().includes('abonnement')) || shopify.line_items[0];
const props = lineItem.properties || [];
const getProp = (name) => (props.find(p => p.name === name)?.value || '').trim();

const sub = {
  email: (shopify.contact_email || shopify.email || '').toLowerCase().trim(),
  firstName: shopify.billing_address?.first_name || shopify.customer?.first_name || '',
  lastName: shopify.billing_address?.last_name || shopify.customer?.last_name || '',
  address1: shopify.billing_address?.address1 || '',
  address2: shopify.billing_address?.address2 || '',
  city: shopify.billing_address?.city || '',
  postcode: shopify.billing_address?.zip || '',
  country: shopify.billing_address?.country_code || 'FR',
  phone: shopify.billing_address?.phone || '',
  customerId: String(shopify.customer?.id || ''),
  orderId: String(shopify.id || ''),
  // Personnage principal
  prenom: getProp('Prénom'),
  age: getProp('Âge'),
  genre: getProp('Genre'),
  imageRef: getProp('_Image'),
  coupe: getProp('_Coupe'),
  couleur: getProp('_Couleur'),
  yeux: getProp('_Yeux'),
  sourcils: getProp('_Sourcils'),
  lunettes: getProp('_Lunettes'),
  accessoires: getProp('_Accessoires'),
  // Personnage secondaire
  hasSecondChar: getProp('Personnage secondaire') === 'Oui',
  imageRef2: getProp('_Image 2'),
  prenom2: getProp('Prénom 2'),
  age2: getProp('Âge 2'),
  genre2: getProp('Genre 2'),
  lien2: getProp('Lien 2'),
  coupe2: getProp('_Coupe 2'),
  couleur2: getProp('_Couleur 2'),
  yeux2: getProp('_Yeux 2'),
  // Abonnement
  couverture: getProp('Couverture') || 'Rigide - 20x20 cm',
  subscribedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  active: true,
  booksGenerated: 0
};

if (!sub.email || !sub.prenom) {
  throw new Error('Données abonné incomplètes : email ou prénom manquant');
}

return [{json: sub}];
